desc: Read input values $N, Q$ and the sequence $A$.
Precompute modular inverses for integers $1$ to $N$ to handle divisions modulo 998244353.
Compute prefix sums of the sequence $B_x = A_x \cdot x^{-1} \pmod{998244353}$ to allow $O(1)$ range sum queries.
For each query $(u, v)$, calculate the answer using the derived formula involving the precomputed prefix sums and factorials, handling edge cases like $u=1$.
Print the results for all queries.
